title: Horology Studio: 3D Watches & Clock Widgets for iPhone
description: Create your own 3D mechanical watch on iPhone. Customize and save designs, add analog clock and World Time widgets, and use alarms and countdown timers.
free: Free download · Optional one-time watch purchases
pricingText: Horology Studio is free to download. Additional watch models and the Complete Collection are available through optional one-time in-app purchases.
pricingNote: See current prices and included models in the app and on the App Store.
heading: Your own mechanical watch
lede: Turn your iPhone into a personal watch collection. Explore mechanical timepieces in 3D, customize their details, and display your favorites as Home Screen widgets.
alarmsNote: Alarms and countdown timers require iOS 26 or later.
localNote: No account is required. Your saved watch designs and alarm settings are stored on your device. Additional watch models are available through in-app purchases.
closingText: Choose a watch, make it yours, and enjoy it every day.

scenes.title: Find Your Signature Piece
text: Discover original watches with distinctive shapes, materials, and complications, including open-heart, chronograph, calendar, and celestial designs.
Rotate your watch in 3D to explore the dial, case, and caseback.
Enjoy a full-screen view that puts your timepiece at the center.

scenes.title: Make Every Detail Yours
text: Choose dials, hands, cases, straps, materials, and finishes.
Personalize movement layouts, date displays, and caseback details, with options tailored to each model.
Save multiple designs for each watch and switch between your favorites.
Share an image of your creation with a personal message and signature.

scenes.title: Your Watch at a Glance
text: Add a small widget featuring your chosen watch design.
Choose a different saved design for each small widget.

scenes.title: World Time at a Glance
text: Set up a World Time widget with four watches and independently selected cities or time zones.

scenes.title: Discover What Makes It Tick
text: Wind the movement, adjust the time with the crown, or synchronize your watch with your device.

scenes.title: Set Alarms with Style
text: Set one-time or weekly alarms with optional snooze.
Count down with a timer that keeps your chosen watch design.

faqs.question: Which devices and iOS versions are supported?
faqs.answer: iPhone · iOS 18+. Alarms and countdown timers require iOS 26 or later.

faqs.question: Can I save more than one watch design?
faqs.answer: Save multiple designs for each watch and switch between your favorites.

faqs.question: Can each widget use a different design?
faqs.answer: Add a small widget featuring your chosen watch design. Choose a different saved design for each small widget.

faqs.question: Can I see several time zones at once?
faqs.answer: Set up a World Time widget with four watches and independently selected cities or time zones.

faqs.question: When can I use alarms and countdown timers?
faqs.answer: Alarms and countdown timers require iOS 26 or later.

faqs.question: Is Horology Studio free?
faqs.answer: Horology Studio is free to download. Additional watch models and the Complete Collection are available through optional one-time in-app purchases.

faqs.question: Do I need an account?
faqs.answer: No account is required. Your saved watch designs and alarm settings are stored on your device. Additional watch models are available through in-app purchases.
